title: An Embedded Ergonomic Posture Monitoring and AI-Assisted Home Learning System on a Raspberry Pi 3B Edge Platform
abstract: During independent home study sessions, students frequently sustain improper sitting postures, accumulate excessive sedentary hours, and experience productivity loss from off-task digital distractions. Furthermore, learners often lack real-time pedagogical scaffolding for demanding self-study curricula. To mitigate these ergonomic and instructional challenges, this paper presents an affordable, privacy-preserving cyber-physical embedded system for domestic study spaces. Engineered on a Raspberry Pi 3 Model B (1 GB RAM) paired with a UVC optical camera and a USB condenser microphone, the system executes on-device computer vision utilizing MediaPipe Pose and OpenCV to monitor upper-body alignment, sagittal head inclination, and coronal shoulder asymmetry in real time without persisting raw video streams. A deterministic finite state machine (FSM) quantifies active study durations, enforces health-compliant rest periods, and detects illicit smartphone usage. Simultaneously, an integrated multimodal AI tutoring agent parses voice and text queries via an encrypted API gateway, synthesizing Socratic conceptual hints rather than direct solutions. A lightweight parental web dashboard delivers encrypted session analytics and scheduling configurations. Empirical benchmarks on the physical prototype confirm an end-to-end inference latency of 244-250 ms at a 352x288 resolution (4.0-4.1 FPS), a trunk-angle estimation error of 4.39 degrees MAE over 5,760 synthetic ground-truth poses, a resident set size of 320 MB, a peak SoC temperature of 58.0 degrees Celsius under sustained load, and a 1.58 s total latency for the offline TTS feedback path, proving high practicality for resource-constrained edge deployment.
abstract_cn: 在独立的家庭学习课程中,学生经常保持不当的坐姿,积累过多的静坐时间,并经历非任务数字分心导致的生产力损失. 此外,学习者往往缺乏要求自学课程的实时教学脚手架。 为缓解这些人类学和教学挑战,本文为国内学习空间提供了一个负担得起的、保护隐私的网络物理嵌入系统。 系统在Raspberry Pi 3型B(1 GBRAM)上与一台UVC光学相机和一台USB收缩式麦克风对接后,利用MediaPipePose和OpenCV执行安装式计算机视觉,以实时监测上体对齐,平面头倾角和冠肩不对称,而无需持续的原始视频流. 确定性的有限状态机器(FSM)将活动学习时间量化,强制实施符合健康要求的休息期,并检测出非法使用智能手机的情况. 同时,一个综合的多式AI辅导代理通过加密的API网关解析语音和文本查询,合成Socratic概念提示而不是直接解决方案. 轻量级家长网络仪表板提供加密会话分析与调度配置. 【该句原文】Empirical benchmarks on the physical prototype confirm an end-to-end inference latency of 244-250 ms at a 352x288 resolution (4.0-4.1 FPS), a trunk-angle estimation error of 4.39 degrees MAE over 5,760 synthetic ground-truth poses, a resident set size of 320 MB, a peak SoC temperature of 58.0 degrees Celsius under sustained load, and a 1.58 s total latency for the offline TTS feedback path, proving high practicality for resource-constrained edge deployment.

innovation_source: To mitigate these ergonomic and instructional challenges, this paper presents an affordable, privacy-preserving cyber-physical embedded system for domestic study spaces.

title: A Differential Computing Accelerator for LLM Inference Leveraging Bit-Slice Transition Sparsity
abstract:
Large language models (LLMs) have become foundational to modern artificial intelligence. Driven by scaling laws, their rapid growth poses increasing computational and memory challenges for deployment. To accelerate the general matrix multiplication (GEMM) operations that dominate LLM computation, bit-slice architectures decompose quantized operands along the bit dimension, exposing slice-level sparsity and redundancy. However, existing bit-slice designs primarily exploit sparsity in high-order slices, while dense low-order slices still offer substantial untapped reuse opportunities.
  We observe that bit-slice vectors (BSVs) are highly clustered in Hamming space, with many BSVs lying only a few bit flips away from a small set of representative patterns. Based on this observation, we propose ISTS, an algorithm-hardware co-designed accelerator that leverages representative BSV patterns as shared Steiner points to reuse partial sums across slices, substantially reducing computation. Specifically, the partial sum of each target BSV can be reconstructed from that of its assigned Steiner point using only a few additions or subtractions. On the algorithmic side, we propose Steiner Absorption Table Construction (SATC), which selects a compact set of Steiner points to absorb BSVs with only a few bidirectional bit flips, while FlipPrune selectively prunes flips to further expand the reusable BSV population. On the hardware side, we design a lightweight accelerator that supports Steiner reuse for static linear layer weights and runtime-generated attention K/V tensors. Comprehensive evaluations show that ISTS achieves average speedups of $3.09\times$, $2.41\times$, $2.18\times$, $1.27\times$, and $1.41\times$ over the state-of-the-art accelerators ANT, BBS, LUT Tensor Core, Transitive Array, and MCBP-BRCR, respectively.
abstract_cn: 大语言模型(LLMs)已经成为现代人工智能的基础. 在缩小定律的推动下,这些定律的迅速发展给部署带来了越来越多的计算和内存挑战。 为了加速主导 LLM 计算的一般矩阵乘法(GEMM)操作,比特切片架构会沿着比特维分解已分解的行法,暴露出切片级的相片和冗余. 然而,现有的比特-切片设计主要利用高序切片中的斯帕氏性,而密集的低序切片仍然提供了大量未被利用的再利用机会. 我们观测到比特切向量(BSVs)被高度聚集在汉明空间中,许多BSVs只躺了几分,远离了一小组代表性图案. 基于这一观察,我们提议ISTS,一个算法-硬件共同设计的加速器,利用具有代表性的BSV模式作为共享的Steiner,指向跨切片再用部分量,大幅降低计算. 具体来说,每个目标BSV的部分和可以从其所分配的Steiner点重建,只使用几个加法或减法. 在算法方面,我们提议Steiner 吸收表构建 (SATC),它选择了一套由Steiner分组成的紧凑集来吸收BSVs分,只有几个双向比特翻转,而FlipPrune有选择地翻转来进一步扩大可再使用的BSV人口. 在硬件方面,我们设计了一种轻量级加速器,支持Steiner对静态线性地层重量的再利用和运行时产生的注意力K/V分数. 综合评价显示,ISTS在最先进的加速器ANT,BBS,LUT Tensor Core,Transitive Array,和MCBP-BRCR上分别实现了3.09×, 2.41×, 2.18×, 1.27×和1.41×的平均速度.
takeaway: 综合评价显示,ISTS在最先进的加速器ANT,BBS,LUT Tensor Core,Transitive Array,和MCBP-BRCR上分别实现了3.09×, 2.41×, 2.18×, 1.27×和1.41×的平均速度.

takeaway_source: Comprehensive evaluations show that ISTS achieves average speedups of 3.09×, 2.41×, 2.18×, 1.27×, and 1.41× over the state-of-the-art accelerators ANT, BBS, LUT Tensor Core, Transitive Array, and MCBP-BRCR, respectively.
innovation_source: Based on this observation, we propose ISTS, an algorithm-hardware co-designed accelerator that leverages representative BSV patterns as shared Steiner points to reuse partial sums across slices, substantially reducing computation.

On the algorithmic side, we propose Steiner Absorption Table Construction (SATC), which selects a compact set of Steiner points to absorb BSVs with only a few bidirectional bit flips, while FlipPrune selectively prunes flips to further expand the reusable BSV population.
On the hardware side, we design a lightweight accelerator that supports Steiner reuse for static linear layer weights and runtime-generated attention K/V tensors.

title: High-Throughput GPU Decoding of Quantum Bivariate Bicycle Codes under Circuit-Level Noise
abstract: Bivariate bicycle (BB) codes reduce the physical-qubit overhead of quantum error correction compared to other codes such as Surface codes, but circuit-level faults create dependencies across measurement rounds that limit decoding throughput. We present a parallel-window GPU decoder that combines reusable fault patterns, compact shared-memory state, and persistent GPU workers using min-sum with Relay-BP recovery. On an RTX 5090, the proposed decoder keeps pace with one syndrome round every 1 $μ$s across all four evaluated codes, up to [[144,12,12]] with 63-144 $μ$s median commit delays. This rate has not been demonstrated in prior circuit-level GPU decoding studies and it provides $120\times$ higher decoding throughput than sequential sliding-window decoding. Checking neighboring detector rounds before accepting a decoding result reduces failure rates by up to 65%. For [[144,12,12]] at $p=0.002$, our proposed decoder achieves $7.58\times 10^{-6}$ failures per round, 36% lower than the published belief propagation (BP) with syndrome flipping (BP-SF) result.
abstract_cn: 相较于Surface代码等其它代码,双变量自行车(BB)代码降低了量子错误校正的物理-qubit间接费用,但电路级断层会形成跨测量回合的依赖性,从而限制对吞吐量的解码. 我们提出一个平行窗口GPU解码器,将可重复使用的断层图案、紧凑的共享-记忆状态和持久性GPU工人使用最小和Relay-BP恢复结合起来。 【该句原文】On an RTX 5090, the proposed decoder keeps pace with one syndrome round every 1 μs across all four evaluated codes, up to [[144,12,12]] with 63-144 μs median commit delays. 这个速率在之前的电路级GPU解码研究中还没有被证明,它提供的解码吞吐量会比相继滑动-窗口解码高120×. 在接受解码结果前先检查相邻的探测器弹出后能将故障率降低至65%. 对于[[144,12,12]]p=0.002,我们提议的解码器每轮的故障为7.58×10 ?? -6},比公布的信仰传播(BP)低36%,结果为综合症翻转(BP-SF)。

title: DiversePlace: Diversity-Seeking Curriculum Reinforcement Learning for Macro Placement
abstract: Macro placement is a critical early-stage decision in physical design because macro locations strongly constrain subsequent implementation stages. The task is difficult because these high-impact discrete decisions must be made before downstream quality can be measured accurately, forcing training to rely on fast but imperfect training-time oracles such as half-perimeter wirelength (HPWL). Existing RL-based placers therefore mostly optimize single HPWL-driven solutions, and their long sequential horizons often require heavy search assistance or offline expert data while leaving little room to preserve multiple competitive layouts. We address this gap by making quality-controlled diversity an explicit objective for macro placement. Instead of relying on a single proxy-optimal solution, we maintain a compact archive of HPWL-competitive yet meaningfully different placements for downstream selection. We realize this idea in DiversePlace, a curriculum proximal policy optimization (PPO) framework that combines a quality-gated diversity reward with an expanding placement horizon, enabling from-scratch RL optimization while keeping exploration inside competitive HPWL regions. On the ISPD2005 benchmarks, DiversePlace consistently improves top-5, top-10, and top-20 archive diversity and achieves lower or virtually identical HPWL on all eight designs with better efficiency. Code: https://github.com/William030422/NIPS2026-DiversePlace.
abstract_cn: 宏观定位是实体设计中关键性的早期决定,因为宏观定位强烈地制约了后续实施阶段. 这项任务很困难,因为必须在准确测量下游质量之前作出这些影响较大的离散决定,迫使培训依赖于快速而不完善的培训时间预言,如半周长(HPWL). 因此,现有的RL-based置放器大多优化了单 HPWL-driven 解决方案,其长相相继的视野往往需要大量搜索协助或离线专家数据,同时为保持多种竞争布局留下了很小的空间. 我们通过将质量控制多样性作为宏观安排的明确目标来解决这一差距。 我们没有依赖单一的代理-最佳解决方案,而是保持一个HPWL-competitive的紧凑档案,但下游选择却有有意义的不同位置。 我们在DiversePlace中意识到了这个想法,即一个课程的近似政策优化(PPO)框架,将质量高的多样化奖励与不断扩大的安置视野相结合,使RL能够实现优化,同时在HPWL区域内保持竞争性探索。 【该句原文】On the ISPD2005 benchmarks, DiversePlace consistently improves top-5, top-10, and top-20 archive diversity and achieves lower or virtually identical HPWL on all eight designs with better efficiency. 代码:https://github.com/William030422/NIPS2026-DiversePlace.

title: Any-Rate: Half-Bit Multi-Precision LLM Quantization with Coded Bit-Planes
abstract: Nested multi-precision quantization derives multiple precisions from a single checkpoint by reading only the leading bits of each weight, which makes it attractive for on-device deployment under varying memory and energy budgets. However, existing methods offer only integer bits, leaving large accuracy gaps between adjacent precisions and severe degradation at 2 bits. To address this, we propose Any-Rate, which serves 2-8 bits from one checkpoint, in half-bit steps over 2-4 bits. Any-Rate restricts some bit-planes to extended Hamming codewords in 8-weight blocks (0.5 bits per weight), shares one LUT per row across precisions, and encodes all precisions jointly with a separate target for each, reducing the loss from sharing bit-planes. Across four LLMs, Any-Rate achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among multi-precision methods at 2 and 3 bits, keeping 69% of FP16 accuracy at 2 bits, and is within one point of the best at 4 bits. It decodes about as fast as existing kernels, and an LPDDR energy model estimates up to 27% less energy at equal accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/hoonki2002/Any-Rate.

title: MixMoMo: Accelerating Extra--Large MoE Inference with Mixed--Precision GPU--NPU Execution on Mobile Devices
abstract: Mobile agents and on-device intelligence increasingly demand more capable models on smartphones. Through sparse expert activation, Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) scales model capacity, yet growing numbers of fine-grained experts complicate loading and computation. Model compression complements expert offloading by reducing storage and computation costs. Among compression techniques, mixed-precision quantization assigns lower expert bitwidths to balance model quality and inference efficiency. However, existing offline metrics and routing scores fail to reflect expert quantization sensitivity, undermining precision assignment. Diverse bitwidths also complicate balanced expert allocation across GPUs and NPUs with distinct execution characteristics, while tile-wise dequantization underutilizes NPU vector parallelism. We present MixMoMo, an efficient mixed-precision inference runtime for extra-large MoE models on heterogeneous mobile SoCs. MixMoMo combines offline quantization-impact profiles with activation-based runtime risk estimates for quality-constrained expert bitwidth assignment. It further adopts precision-structured execution for balanced GPU-NPU expert allocation and HVX-parallel dequantization for efficient NPU vector utilization. Across three MoE models and five benchmarks on two mobile platforms, MixMoMo achieves average decoding speedups of 3.72x over uniform Q4_0 and 1.53x over the strongest mixed-precision MoE baseline.
abstract_cn: 移动代理和机上智能越来越需要智能手机上更有能力的模型. 通过稀缺的专家活化,Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)的尺度模型容量,然而越来越多的精细磨损的专家使加载和计算变得复杂. 模型压缩通过降低存储和计算成本来补充专家卸载. 在压缩技术中,混合精度量化指派了更低的专家比特widths来平衡模型质量和推理效率. 然而,现有的离线计量和路由分数未能反映专家的量化敏感性,破坏了精准分配。 不同的比特widths还使平衡的专家分配在具有不同执行特性的GPUs和NPUs之间复杂化,而平滑的去正分化则使NPU向量平行化. 我们介绍 MixMoMo,一个高效的混合精度 推理 运行时间,用于在 异构 移动 SoCs 上超大 MoE 型号. MixMoMo 将离线量化-影响剖面与基于激活的运行时间风险估计结合,用于质量受限的专家比特width任务. 它进一步采用精确结构化的执行,以平衡地分配GPU-NPU专家,并采用HVX-parallel分级方法,以高效地利用NPU向量。 【该句原文】Across three MoE models and five benchmarks on two mobile platforms, MixMoMo achieves average decoding speedups of 3.72x over uniform Q4_0 and 1.53x over the strongest mixed-precision MoE baseline.

title: Kolpona: An Agentic Framework with Gradient-Free Neuron Programming for RTL Generation
abstract: Open-weight large language models (LLMs) for register-transfer level (RTL) design are usually improved by fine-tuning on curated Verilog corpora, which needs large sets of verified designs and GPU training. We present Kolpona, an agentic framework that improves such models without gradient training. Its first component is neuron programming, a new form of weight-space programming (WSP) that writes single neurons in closed form into the weights to remove failure habits found on practice tasks, and keeps each edit only when testbench results on fresh tasks favour it. At inference time, tool-using agents propose designs, and a label-free selection stage delivers one design per task from the specification, the candidates and their simulations alone. On Qwen3.5-4B, edits to 16 neurons raise the VerilogEval v2 pass@1 of the model alone from 31.7% to 55.4%, and the full framework reaches 77.6%. On Qwen3.8-27B, Kolpona lifts pass@1 from 73.1% to 94.9% on VerilogEval v2 and from 66.0% to 92.0% on RTLLM v2.1 on a single 32 GB GPU, above every published system in our comparison. The RTL edits also carry over to Python and raise the pass@1 of the 4B model alone from 84.8% to 91.5% on HumanEval+ and from 67.7% to 77.5% on MBPP+.
abstract_cn: 用于寄存器传输级(RTL)设计的开口量级大语言模型(LLMs)通常通过对被曲解的Verilog corpora进行微调来改进,这需要大量的可验证设计和GPU培训. 我们提出Kolpona,即一个不经过梯度训练而改进这种模型的智能体式框架。 它的第一个组成部分是神经元编程,这是一种新型的重空编程(WSP),将单个神经元以封闭的形式写入权重来去除练习任务所发现的故障习惯,只有在试管结果对新任务有利时,才保持每次编辑. 在 推理 时间,工具使用代理提出设计,一个无标签的选择阶段从规格,候选者及其模拟中提供每个任务一个设计. 在Quen3.5-4B上,编辑到16个神经元将单型号的 VerilogEval v2 pass@1从31.7%提升到55.4%,全框架达到77.6%. 【该句原文】On Qwen3.8-27B, Kolpona lifts pass@1 from 73.1% to 94.9% on VerilogEval v2 and from 66.0% to 92.0% on RTLLM v2.1 on a single 32 GB GPU, above every published system in our comparison. 【该句原文】The RTL edits also carry over to Python and raise the pass@1 of the 4B model alone from 84.8% to 91.5% on HumanEval+ and from 67.7% to 77.5% on MBPP+.

title: Algebraic Diversity of Switching Functions
abstract: Algebraic Diversity generalizes averaging over many observations to averaging one observation over a group of transformations matched to its structure. This paper develops the framework on the Boolean cube $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ for the translations, the coordinate permutations, the hyperoctahedral group, and the general linear and affine groups. It determines the commutant of each action and gives closed forms for the group-averaged second-order statistic of one truth table, which collapses to the Walsh periodogram for the translations, to per-weight averages for the hyperoctahedral group, and to the weight up to complementation for the affine group. Bent functions are exactly those whose translation average is white, the Haar transform along an input order is the multiplexer tree of Shannon's expansion, and higher-order averages see only the weight below a first informative order, two for the translations and four for the affine group. A matched stabilizer stands in for repeated observations, since a vote over orbits of $s$ points divides by $s$ the number of noisy truth tables a target error requires. The same viewpoint gives the affine hull of a function as matched coordinates, an exact variance identity for XOR hashing, and matched hashes whose variance never exceeds that of a pairwise independent hash. Applications on public benchmarks include hash choice for approximate model counting, the decision of parity-structured formulas and the refutation of counting formulas modulo 3 and 4 from the spectra of clause blocks, separation of NPN classes by canonical spectra, tested on ISCAS-85 cut functions and all five-input classes, correction of noisy truth tables and protection of lookup tables by voting over symmetries, blind group matching, and an analog of the CLEAN algorithm that writes a truth table as the XOR of atoms in the fixed spaces of groups. All proofs are given in full.

title: GPS: Guiding Phase-Level Prefetcher Selection with Data-Driven Method
abstract:
Hardware prefetching is a widely used technique for hiding off-chip memory latency. Modern processors increasingly adopt composite prefetchers that combine multiple prefetching engines to handle the diverse memory access patterns found in real applications. However, coordinating multiple prefetchers requires a policy selection algorithm that maps observed system feedback to appropriate prefetching policies. Existing approaches suffer from two key limitations. First, relying on only a small set of features can lead to misleading prefetcher policies due to incomplete visibility into the system state. Second, limited on-chip hardware resources force these designs to use simple mapping mechanisms that cannot effectively navigate the large prefetching policy space.
  To address these challenges, we propose GPS, a data-driven framework for prefetcher selection that leverages comprehensive profiling and offline learning. GPS collects a rich set of features that capture both system behaviors and hardware resource states, and uses an offline machine learning model to learn the mapping between these features and the IPC-best policy. By offloading complex policy generation to software, GPS eliminates the need for costly online exploration and enables lightweight runtime execution through pre-generated policy hints. GPS reduces the performance gap to only 2.6%, compared to 13.6% and 14.2% in prior state-of-the-art methods. We evaluate GPS on SPEC CPU2006, SPEC CPU2017, and GAP benchmark suites. GPS outperforms the state-of-the-art prefetcher selection method I-POP by 12.14%, 8.34%, and 14.17% in geometric-mean IPC, respectively. GPS achieves these gains with only 778 bits of additional on-chip storage for runtime policy control.

title: L2C2: Enhancing Large-scale Chiplets for Agent Long-Context LLM Inference with Sparse and Distributed Attention
abstract: Long-context inference is a rising demand for LLMs, especially for agent applications. Sparse attention (SpAt) and chiplet technology are promising solutions to reduce computations and scale hardware performance. However, deploying SpAt on distributed chiplets necessitates context parallelism for workload partitioning, introducing complex distributed attention. In this work, we present L2C2, a system optimization for distributed SpAt in long-context inference. During the partial-prefill stage, we propose a novel Split-Comm Attention mechanism that leverages the high-bandwidth interconnect of chiplets to trade communication overhead for reduced memory access. We combine it with conventional Ring Attention to form a Bi-Mode method that adapts to varying input sequence lengths. During the decoding stage, we analyze the cause of memory access imbalance and address it by static interleaved token assignment. Dynamic agile cache balancing is also proposed to adapt to SpAt skewness. Evaluations show our optimization can achieve 1.45$\times$ and 1.53$\times$ speedup in partial-prefill and decoding with SpAt on large-scale chiplets.
